sources.title: 奎章閣 GK00892_00 姜保《授時曆捷法立成》第一方馆藏目录、甲寅字印本与 M/F66-1-1-A 对应
sources.provider: Kyujanggak Institute for Korean Studies / Seoul National University
sources.quality_notes: Official GK00892_00 / 奎貴892 names 姜保, 1冊46張, 甲寅字 and M/F66-1-1-A. The code matches an independently registered 1966 SNU film inventory while not proving ancient numeric data or current image access. Catalog inline 至正八年(1316) conflicts with era chronology 1348 and is preserved as an unresolved catalog-display mismatch; no original colophon review. Do not merge with distinct G893 GK00893_00.
